purpose: Fixed companion declarations captured once from actual derived source TypeScript AST; later reads must match. Ordinary source and behavior remain the strict patch baseline.

testAfterSettlement.lifetime: Caller supplies checked Runtime; its Session retains exactly one one-shot future-settlement callback. context_owner=caller refers to that supplied Runtime owner, not call scope. source-lease is the Session one-shot retention until invoke/clear; no Core subscription or second waiter.

testFailAfterSettlement.lifetime: Checked Runtime Session owns one next-settlement fault slot; no new native waiter/payload.

testSubscriptionState.lifetime: Read-only copy of the original held Subscription wrapper record, including after close; no new native reference or observer owner; not GC evidence.

testBeforeRuntimeReceipt.lifetime: Checked Runtime Session retains one synchronous void probe before close. At genuine physical ACK with no waiters, the slot clears before invocation and receipt consumption; failure clears it. No native gate, owner or waiter. Nonundefined return rejects InvalidArgument without awaiting/inspecting the returned object; callback throw follows the existing failed-close path with receipt unconsumed. User Error identity is preserved without property inspection; non-Error throws or Error-classification traps normalize to existing CallbackFailure. This test-only catch rejects the original close before receipt consumption and keeps the ordinary tick finally.

notes: Public contract derives Boundary.ets exported syntax. Gateway is mechanism linkage; provider ABI is separate private C seam, not public resource metadata.
TypeScript number does not imply Int32; this explicit policy assigns Snapshot.value Int32 and text strict bounded UTF-8.
Native pointers have no inferred ownership; provider protocol remains explicit ADR0013 plus paired same-provider release seam.
No business Promise cancellation from garbage collection or dropping wait.
State capacity_items=3 bounds one pending, one entered, and one staging reservation per selected subscription; all staging copies count in the shared 4096 retained UTF-8 budget.
Callback context_owner=subscription-owner describes the persistent listener registration. keep_alive=source-lease describes in-flight producer/delivery retention until lawful callback exit/drop.
Logical erased error channel ArkTSError admits unmodified user Error as well as BoundaryError. Actual BoundaryError.code declaration stays in the compiler descriptor; no exhaustive enum is inferred.
calling_convention=system is an explicit backend logical convention, not a physical C ABI derived from .ets. Physical private C layout remains separate Clang evidence.
Stream classification comes from this explicit policy; TypeScript AST supplies method/callback signatures and Promise return syntax, not stream lifecycle semantics.

State capacity_items counts retained version responsibilities, not a public queue depth: latest pending remains one slot, entered callback and pre-commit staging have distinct owners. All count in the shared 4096-byte budget.
Shared resource self/return slots are backend reference handles whose explicit close belongs to the public owner. The erased ArkTSError channel is owned by ArkTS and is not a closable SDK resource.
Each call carries an authored stable public_id. SourceKey and API shape remain independently compiler-derived; retaining an ID across an explicit rename does not assert shape compatibility.

Test diagnostic number[] is a logical backend array, represented by existing buffer(elements,none,copy) without asserting contiguous C storage. Each element is an exact JS-safe integer; field units/ranges and temporal consistency are frozen separately.
Runtime-owned one-shot settlement hooks are distinct from subscription listeners and remain retained after registration returns. Test-only role policy never broadens ordinary reader acceptance.

C09 test-only before-receipt probe uses the existing physical ACK predicate and original close owner; open registration once, Closing/Closed/failed admission preserved. Declaration callback must return void; runtime rejects every nonundefined return, including Promise and thenable.

error_channel.meaning: Backend-owned erased ArkTS exception channel, including ordinary BoundaryError(code) and unmodified user Error. Not a finite error enum or an explicitly closable SDK owner.
